session_notes: Opened 7 separate CODAP instances (one per variable). Built 7 depth-1 trees then combined thresholds into multi-depth tree. Strong B10 (collects local optima per variable). Misconception about MCR=0 as goal ('0'a ulaşana kadar ekleyelim mi'). No test/train distinction made.

B10.note: Built 7 depth-1 single-variable trees, read each MCR, then selected thresholds for a combined depth-4 tree. Each single-variable tree was purposefully built to assess that variable in isolation before combining. B10-D2 — subgroup split rationale via single-variable benchmarking strategy.

B9.note: No Choosy, no train/test split observed in entire session. Entire analysis on training data. not_observed (not not_measurable — action was available and not taken).
B9.quote: Hocam buraya ekleye ekleye devam mı edeceğiz 0'a ulaşana kadar?

B13.note: Henry reads MCR only. No sensitivity engagement. No trade-off framing. not_observed.
